texts390.text: A free on-chain pet. A little place to call home.
Hatch one pet per wallet, free. Its fur, little treasures, and entire story live on Sepoli
No game fee. A little Sepolia ETH for network gas.
Your pet grows with settled Squeek blocks. Dress it in the treasures it brings home.
Choose a trail, then come back once its rounds settle. Every return brings a Seed Capsule.
Rest is part of the story
A quiet wheel brings Dream treasures at the same odds. There is never a reason to push.
